Customer: Ji, mein hi Anil Sharma bol raha hoon. Kaisi hain?
Agent: Main theek hoon sir. Aapka personal loan account PL123456 ka EMI due date 5th August ko tha, aur abhi tak aapka Rs. 10,000 ka bhugtaan nahi hua hai. Kya main jan sakti hoon kya hua hai?
Customer: Haan, mujhe pata hai. Main isi baare mein baat karne ke liye aapke call ka wait kar raha tha, ya main aapko call karne hi wala tha. Dekhiye, meri salary thodi delay ho gayi hai iss mahine, aur company mein bhi kuch issues ki wajah se thodi kam bhi aayi hai. Toh isliye, mai abhi full EMI pay nahi kar paa raha hoon.
Agent: Oh, theek hai sir. Toh abhi aap kya plan kar rahe hain payment ke liye? Humein aapki taraf se koi bhi update nahi mila tha.
Customer: Dekhiye, meri financial position abhi thodi tight chal rahi hai. Mai chah raha tha ki kya hum is EMI amount ko temporary basis pe kam kar sakte hain? Ya kuch mahino ke liye ek moratorium mil sakta hai, matlab thoda time mill jaaye pay karne ke liye? Jaise hi meri salary normal hogi, mai dobara full EMI payment start kar dunga. Ya phir loan ka tenure thoda badha kar meri EMI thodi kam kar di jaaye toh kafi help hogi.
Agent: Sir, mein aapki baat samajh sakti hoon. Salary delay aur kam income ki wajah se yeh situation bani hai. Aap jo restructure ya EMI reduction ki baat kar rahe hain, uske liye ek proper process hota hai. Aapko humare customer care ko kuch required documents submit karne honge. Aap humari website par bhi online application form fill kar sakte hain. Aapke request ko assess kiya jayega aur agar approve hua toh hum aapko revised terms bata denge. Kya aap iski process janana chahenge?
Customer: Haan, bilkul. Agar EMI thodi kam ho jaye ya do-teen mahine ka relief mil jaye, toh mere liye kafi help hogi. Abhi main Rs. 10,000 ek saath pay nahi kar paunga. Kya interest rate par bhi koi farak padega agar tenure badhta hai?
Agent: Sir, jab aap restructure ke liye request karte hain, toh naye terms aur conditions bank dwara decide kiye jaate hain. Ismein loan tenure, interest rates, aur EMI amount sab revise ho sakta hai. Aapki application par review ke baad hi hum aapko final details de payenge. Hum aapko ek email par required documents ki list aur application process bhej dete hain. Aapko apni latest salary slip aur ek application letter dena hoga.
Customer: Theek hai, theek hai. Please mujhe woh details jald se jald bhej dijiye. Main documents submit kar deta hoon. Bas mujhe relief mil jaye, nahi toh thodi mushkil ho jayegi.
Agent: Theek hai Mr. Sharma, main aapko email kar deti hoon. Aur koi assistance chahiye aapko?
Customer: Nahi, bas yahi hai. Shukriya.

Jab tak woh clear nahi hota, main koi payment nahi kar paaunga. Main try kar raha hoon jaldi se jaldi bank se baat karoon.
